summary:
Iteration 24 — PayPal env-fallback + admin 测试连线 button + /webhook/paypal + top-up footnote tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_paypal_env_fallback.py (JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter24_results.xml). Covered: (1) /api/me/wallet/topup/checkout with PayPal method & empty creds → 503 'PayPal 尚未設定 Client ID / Secret'. (2) /api/admin/payment-methods/{paypal}/test with empty creds → 503 '尚未設定'; with cfg {client_id:'AbcTest',api_secret:'wrongsecret',env:'sandbox'} → 502 'PayPal 憑證無效' (verified via localhost:8001 because public ingress rewrites upstream 502 to CloudFlare HTML); checkout with same bad creds → 502; restored to empty → 503 (confirmed). (3) Stripe .../test → 200 {ok:true, provider:'stripe', webhook_url ends with /api/webhook/stripe}. (4) Manual bank .../test → 400. (5) Unknown mid .../test → 404. (6) Missing admin headers → 401/403. (7) POST /api/webhook/paypal {event_type:'PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED', resource:{custom_id:'nope'}} → 200 {status:'ignored'}. (8) empty body / non-JSON webhook → 4xx/5xx without killing the service (GET /api/payment-methods still 200 after).

Frontend member (/account/wallet/topup, zh-CN, 1920x1000): logged in as tester+clerk_test. Payment method cards: 5 providers (USDT, Stripe-card, Stripe-ewallet, PayPal, manual bank). PayPal card selected → topup-footnote = '将跳转至安全收银台，付款完成后自动入帐' ✓. Bank card → '转帐后请于充值记录上传凭证，人工核对后入帐' ✓. USDT card → topup-footnote absent (count=0) ✓. PayPal + topup-preset-50 + topup-submit → network 503 and sonner toast 'PayPal 尚未設定 Client ID / Secret' ✓; URL unchanged (no PayPal redirect) ✓.

Frontend admin (/admin/login + TOTP, zh-CN, 1920x1000): 支付管理 page loaded. pm-test-<id> present only on Stripe (both) and PayPal rows; USDT and 銀行轉帳 rows have no pm-test button ✓. Click pm-test on Stripe → toast 'Stripe 连接成功 / Webhook 网址：http://.../api/webhook/stripe' ✓. Click pm-test on PayPal → toast 'PayPal 尚未設定 Client ID / Secret' ✓. Opened pm-edit-<paypal_id>: config form includes pm-form-cfg-client_id, pm-form-cfg-api_secret, pm-form-cfg-env, pm-form-cfg-webhook_id (all count=1) ✓.

Post-test state: PayPal method config restored to {client_id:'', api_secret:'', env:'sandbox'}, active=true (verified via GET /api/admin/payment-methods).

issues: Stripe 测试连线 toast webhook_url 使用 http:// 内部 cluster URL（crossborder-topup.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud）而非前端 REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL（https 外部域名），管理员看到 http 可能疑惑。来自 request.base_url。建议后端用 APP_PUBLIC_URL 或替换 scheme=https。

action_items: 可选：/admin/payment-methods/{mid}/test 返回的 webhook_url 来自 request.base_url，当请求经过内部 ingress 时返回 http:// 内部主机名。考虑使用 APP_PUBLIC_URL 环境变量或 X-Forwarded-Proto 替换 scheme=https，让管理员看到的 Webhook URL 与真实外部地址一致（这是真要配到 PayPal/Stripe webhook 时需要的）。
可选：Stripe pm-test toast 文案 '连接成功' 与 spec 预期 '连线成功' 不一致（功能无影响）。
critical_code_review_comments: payments_api._paypal_cfg 的 env 回退写得很干净：DB 填空字串自动走 PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID 等。建议 PUT /admin/payment-methods 时，若 config.api_secret 为空字串，不要覆盖已存在的加密密文（目前写法会覆盖）。此次把密钥改空字串刚好符合测试需求，但在生产环境里管理员若无意保存一次就把 .env 回退的凭证清空了，容易误伤 — 可以改成仅当 api_secret 为空字串时跳过写入。
paypal_webhook 入口 await request.json() 对空 body / 非 JSON 会抛 JSONDecodeError → FastAPI 500。虽然服务未被打死（已验证），但建议 try/except 包起来返回 400，避免 500 刷日志。
admin_payment_method_test 对 paypal 用 _paypal_token 做试调，可能在 PayPal 慢回应时触发 20s httpx 超时 → 502。建议把 timeout 调小一点（如 10s）给前端更快反馈。

rca of the issue: N/A — all expected scenarios pass. Only cosmetic observations: (a) admin pm-test Stripe toast reads '连接成功' not '连线成功'; (b) webhook_url returned from /admin/payment-methods/{mid}/test uses request.base_url (http://internal-cluster-host) rather than the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — admins should still manually enter the external https URL when configuring PayPal/Stripe webhooks.
